# id: PG-gate-82-balance-cooking
# covers: PG 187 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# gate: validation gate (RUN_ORDER.md): g1 skill 25 gear none, g2 skill 25 gear own50, g3 skill 90 gear none, g4 skill 25 gear none, same fixture and method as the matrix file
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Avarek + Beaks)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold; 6933d0f: fill topup, drop all; 616121b: benches near; c4fa520: pin, d91fe88: face) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: Beaks works the Cooking Stove (real craft job, Dried Meat queued 5 more per point); the bench input is refilled
#   with Raw Meat before every 30-game-minute window at speed 3. Result = items made in the window:
#   queue drop + progress of the first queued item (benches prints it with 4 decimals, harness
#   after 33087EDE). Skills 10/90 without gear, then 3 x (skill 50: none / +25% / +50% cooking / +50%
#   Labouring control), then the sanity pair.
# verify: every window has a BAL2 line with Q/F values on both sides and made > 0 at skill 50;
#   own > none = the bench reads the hooked stat.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Avarek on
protect Beaks on
health Beaks 100
health Avarek 100
blood Beaks 100%
blood Avarek 100%
hunger Beaks 280
hunger Avarek 280
select Beaks
clearjobs Beaks
pg_statprobe on Beaks
wake Avarek
pin Avarek ~ pinned
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 30 ~ moved=1
build "Cooking Stove" near Beaks dist 10
speed 1 hold
@sleep 2
speed 0
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks building "Cooking Stove" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek off ~ unpinned
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 8 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek ~ pinned
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 8 ~ moved=1
benches 60 crafts ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*Dried Meat
power "Cooking Stove" supply radius 60
give Beaks "Iron Hat" 1
equip Beaks "Iron Hat"
pg_info Beaks "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- g1: skill 25, gear none ---
setstat Beaks cooking 25
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
pg_bonus Beaks cooking ~ equipped_bonus=0% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks building "Cooking Stove" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek off ~ unpinned
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 8 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek ~ pinned
craft Beaks "Dried Meat" at "Cooking Stove" count 5 ~ queued
fill "Cooking Stove" "Raw Meat" 15 radius 60 topup
@echo READY
where Beaks ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*(?:\|[^|]+)*?\| in\d[^|]*\[Raw Meat x[1-9]
benches 8 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=[1-9]
jobs Beaks ~ jobs=[1-9]
building "Cooking Stove" 60 ~ power_on=1 .*broken=0 .*(wants=0(\.0+)?\s|supplied=1)
@set Q0 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@set F0 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)
stat Beaks cooking ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 3 hold
@wait-game 30 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Beaks cooking
where Beaks
jobs Beaks
@echo POST
where Beaks ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
benches 8 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove
@set Q1 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@set F1 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)
@echo BAL2,187,cooking,25,0,none,g1,craft,T${T0}_${T1},${Q0}/${F0},${Q1}/${F1}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Beaks 280
# --- g2: skill 25, gear own50 ---
setstat Beaks cooking 25
pg_clear Beaks ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Beaks "Iron Hat" cooking 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Beaks cooking ~ equipped_bonus=50% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks building "Cooking Stove" dist 4 radius 1500 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek off ~ unpinned
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 8 ~ moved=1
pin Avarek ~ pinned
craft Beaks "Dried Meat" at "Cooking Stove" count 5 ~ queued
fill "Cooking Stove" "Raw Meat" 15 radius 60 topup
@echo READY
where Beaks ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*(?:\|[^|]+)*?\| in\d[^|]*\[Raw Meat x[1-9]
benches 8 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=[1-9]
jobs Beaks ~ jobs=[1-9]
building "Cooking Stove" 60 ~ power_on=1 .*broken=0 .*(wants=0(\.0+)?\s|supplied=1)
@set Q0 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@set F0 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)
stat Beaks cooking ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 3 hold
@wait-game 30 900
speed 0
@set T1 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
stat Beaks cooking
where Beaks
jobs Beaks
@echo POST
where Beaks ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
benches 8 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove
@set Q1 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@set F1 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)
@echo BAL2,187,cooking,25,50,own50,g2,craft,T${T0}_${T1},${Q0}/${F0},${Q1}/${F1}
pg_statprobe read
hunger Beaks 280
# --- g3: skill 90, gear none ---

benches 8 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=[1-9]
jobs Beaks ~ jobs=[1-9]
building "Cooking Stove" 60 ~ power_on=1 .*broken=0 .*(wants=0(\.0+)?\s|supplied=1)
@set Q0 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@set F0 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)

@set T0 time ~ game_hours=([\d.]+)
speed 3 hold
@wait-game 30 900

@echo POST

benches 8 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove
@set Q1 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=(\d+)
@set F1 benches 60 near Beaks ~ Cooking Stove[^|]*queue=\d+ \(first: [^|]*? ([\d.]+)%\)
@echo BAL2,187,cooking,90,0,none,g3,craft,T${T0}_${T1},${Q0}/${F0},${Q1}/${F1}
pg_statprobe read
